prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: 3D model texture-source albedo view, not a concept redesign.
Paint the supplied plain grey orthographic guide IN PLACE. The guide is the immutable geometry authority: preserve its exact 1024 x 1024 canvas, outline, size, position, angle, every polygon edge, part, opening and overlap. Do not move or invent geometry. The other input design_reference.png is ONLY the approved material/color design authority, not the camera or silhouette.
Materials: worn white/ivory ceramic armour with narrow aged gold/brass trim on the existing plate edges, gold roll cage and existing fasteners, dark grey steel joints and pistons, black cables, subtle scuffs, hairline ceramic cracks, worn edges and ash dust. Paint yellow-and-black diagonal industrial hazard stripes along the existing fork blades. Preserve all model shapes even where they are simpler than the design reference. Do not add the reference's extra mechanisms or change any limbs.
LIGHTING: this is pure ALBEDO for projection onto a 3D mesh. Even flat shadowless viewer-facing illumination. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no cavity shading, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light. Dark materials should have readable uniform dark-grey/black base colors rather than light-dependent black holes. Glowing parts if present use their orange base color without light spill.
Output one image only, 1024 x 1024, true transparent RGBA background. No background, floor, text, labels, border or contact shadow. Keep the original guide alpha silhouette pixel-aligned, including all internal transparent openings. Do not crop, reframe or scale.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 (guide_left.png) is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 (design_reference.png) is the MATERIAL REFERENCE. Produce paint_left.png: LEFT elevation; the feet and back are at frame left, the long paired forks point RIGHT. Keep this exact guide camera. Recolor its visible surfaces only.
reason: Rejected: native return is 1254x1254 instead of 1024x1024, geometry and silhouette differ from the guide, and baked lighting remains.
